name: Elymas
whenBasis: Paul and Barnabas's first journey, before the Jerusalem council of ≈AD 48–49, counting back from the Gallio date.
summary: A Jewish sorcerer and false prophet named Bar-Jesus, attendant of the proconsul Sergius Paulus at Paphos. He opposed Barnabas and Saul and tried to turn the proconsul from the faith. Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, called him a child of the devil and enemy of all righteousness and told him he would be blind for a time; mist and darkness came over him, and he groped about for someone to lead him by the hand.
body: Luke says Elymas is what his name means, sorcerer.

media.caption: The blinding of Elymas, Agostino Veneziano after Raphael, engraving, 1516, Metropolitan Museum of Art.
